reason: The budget caps and loop guard speak right to my fear, so I'm interested. But pre-alpha from one developer, running unattended on our agent quota overnight, is a risk I won't pay $99 a month to take. I'd let a dev try the free self-hosted version first.
objection: If the one developer's guardrails have a bug, a run burns our tokens all night and I find out at 8am. Pre-alpha software with nobody behind it doesn't get trusted with our spend.
would_change_my_mind: A month of our own self-hosted runs that stayed inside budget and shipped PRs we actually merged, plus proof the project has more than one person behind it.
